blocks.text: arranging for the education and training of those who come from outside, performing acts of worship, hosting guests, and so on.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فيِ بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ لا يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَاْلآصَالِ ۞ رِجَالٌ لا لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَّلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلوةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكوةِ لا يَخَافُونَ يَوْماً تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَاْلاَبْصَارُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: In the houses (of Allah), Allah has commanded that they be raised (and honoured through acts of worship) and that His holy name be mentioned in them; in them (the righteous servants) glorify Him morning and evening. (Those who glorify Him thus are) men whom neither trade nor (buying and) selling makes heedless of remembering Allah, of establishing Salah and of giving Zakat; and they fear a Day in which hearts and eyes will be overturned (with terror).

blocks.text:
Note:- What is called houses refers to the masjids. The honour due to the masjids: that one on whom a bath (ghusl) is obligatory does not enter the masjid, that nothing impure is taken into the masjid, that no shouting or commotion is made, that one must not talk about worldly matters or do worldly work, and that one must not enter the masjid after eating things that give off a bad smell.
(Bayan-ul-Qur'an)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: أَحَبُّ الْبِلَادِ إِلَي اللهِ تَعَالَي مَسَاجِدُهَا، وَأَبْغَضُ الْبِلَادِ إِلَي اللهِ أَسْوَاقُهَا.
